name: mainline_role_source_holdout_v1
source_protocol: Reuse Stage36 fixed4 whole-physical-policy folds, shared across2 source families.48training+16held per family; all response-dependent current and native source fitting sees only48. Frozen source fit recipes,1024nodes,8identities and latent_shared role g split. Refit per fold because Stage36 saved only forecasts, not model objects.
operator: Use deployed role_inputs/role_trajectory unchanged at actual source d50; source0 projection uses independent task uncertainty just as deployed. This is familiar-source-family held-policy validation of the modular recipe, not exact same-source-task Bayesian conditioning. Stage36 used a different same-task f-only conditional operator, so results are not direct replications.
adaptation: First raw paired[f,g] from each of the first2 held policy IDs, in fixed order. Full propagates both. Point_from_source0 updates only each observed physical policy. Point_after_first shares the full first-anchor posterior, then second-anchor update affects only that policy.14other held policies stay unobserved.
forecast_barrier: Write all4folds x2family forecasts before loading held scoring labels. Training archives exclude every raw at all16held policies. Prediction uses only2 explicitly permitted pairedraw rows; no target geometry or outcomes enter.
metrics: Scoring14 points uses3 rawmeans/variances; g subtracts task tau. MSE,bias,noise-subtractedMSE and moment predictive calibration distinguish mean vs noise. Eta_g uses unbiased logsamplevariance label. f relative ranking reference is firstanchor unused2raw. No true chance-feasibility labels, simulated deployments or exact mixture log-density claim.
statistical_unit: 2 source families; report4 overlapping folds within each family and equal-family aggregate.112policy-family pairs are descriptive, not112independent tasks.
limits: Deployed d1000 model stays frozen. Joint f/g observations may change shared identity weights. Finite3repeat labels are noisy; retain negative noise-subtractedMSE. Existing source sampler precision and lowESSflags retained, no extra quadrature or risk patch screening.
next_step_gate: Interpret full minus point_after_first first; separate initialization benefit versus point_from_source0. No correction adopted on this validation alone. Any later candidate needs source support and fresh target geometry validation; Stage41 targetoutcomes are never tuningdata.

posthoc_saved_moment_diagnostic.scope: Read saved moments for all scoring policies at all three prefixes; compare exp(Eeta), the moment-matched Gaussian exponential moment, and the actual saved noise expectation. No source refit, posterior restoration, simulator, truth, or model change.
posthoc_saved_moment_diagnostic.cost: Recorded separately in noise_moments.json; original fit/scoring ledger unchanged.
